def compute_max_radii_iterative(centers):
    n = centers.shape[0]
    
    # Compute distance matrix
    dists = np.zeros((n, n))
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            d = np.sqrt(np.sum((centers[i] - centers[j])**2))
            dists[i, j] = d
            dists[j, i] = d
    
    # Wall distances
    wall_dist = np.zeros(n)
    for i in range(n):
        x, y = centers[i]
        wall_dist[i] = min(x, y, 1.0 - x, 1.0 - y)
    
    # Initialize radii to wall distance limits
    radii = wall_dist.copy()
    
    # Iteratively adjust radii to resolve overlaps while maximizing sum
    for iteration in range(200):
        changed = False
        for i in range(n):
            max_r = wall_dist[i]
            for j in range(n):
                if i != j:
                    max_r = min(max_r, dists[i, j] - radii[j])
            max_r = max(max_r, 0.0)
            if abs(radii[i] - max_r) > 1e-10:
                radii[i] = max_r
                changed = True
        if not changed:
            break
    
    return radii
